panel.label: Task details
panel.notInVersion: not in v{{version}}, showing the current definition
panel.newInVersion: new in v{{version}}, the Task is created when v{{version}} is approved
panel.archived: The project is Archived: view only, nothing can be changed.
panel.activateRule: Execute only when Ready and readiness Passed; always asks for confirmation. One Task at a time.
panel.activateBlocked: The Task is {{status}}: it cannot be executed yet. Execute only when Ready and readiness Passed.
panel.activateConsequence: {{agent}} will start a workflow for this Task. Follow it in Agent Activity; you can stop the workflow midway.
panel.startConsequence: The Task moves to In Progress and waits for your result. No agent runs this Task.
panel.dequeueConsequence: The Task goes back to Ready; no workflow starts.
panel.reopenConsequence: The Task goes back to Ready; the accepted result stays in the history.
panel.cancelConsequence: The Task becomes Cancelled and no longer runs. Artifacts already created are kept.
panel.reloaded: The Task changed elsewhere; the latest copy was reloaded.
panel.historyFailed: Could not load the workflow history
panel.neverRun: Never run. The first run shows here with the artifacts it creates.
